description_en: Crispy fried spring rolls filled with vegetables and shrimp

ingredients_zh: 春卷皮、虾、卷心菜、胡萝卜、蘑菇、酱油

description_en: Spicy and numbing tofu dish with minced pork and Sichuan peppercorn sauce
description_zh: 辛辣而麻木的豆腐菜，配肉末和四川花椒酱
ingredients_en: Soft tofu, ground pork, Sichuan peppercorn, chili oil, garlic, ginger, soy sauce
ingredients_zh: 嫩豆腐、肉末、四川花椒、辣油、大蒜、生姜、酱油

ingredients_zh: 鸡胸肉、花生、干红辣椒、青椒、酱油、醋、糖、大蒜

ingredients_zh: 西兰花、豌豆荚、胡萝卜、青椒、大蒜、酱油、麻油、生姜

description_zh: 脆鸡配橙子和生姜酱，带一点辣椒
